card.name: Deference and reporting to a superior
card.fires_on: Words in narrative text where someone defers to, serves, waits on, or reports to a higher-ranking person, such as 'to' after a verb of commissioning or coming before a lord. It also fires on forms of address like Señor or Execution-er.

modes.label: Approach or command
modes.description: 'to' or a verb right after someone is commissioned by or comes before a ruler or official.
modes.example: commissioning Palissy<< to>> build a private grotto for her

modes.label: Waiting or asking leave
modes.description: Verbs of waiting or asking a master for permission.
modes.example: You have to wait and<< ask>> me if there is anything you do not

modes.label: Servile address and ranks
modes.description: Titles and ranked servants or soldiers tied to a hierarchy.

card.writes: It pushes toward words of reporting, obedience and submission, and away from words of mutuality and friendship.
card.plain: It lights up where a person answers to a superior, such as obeying, serving, waiting on or reporting to them.
